Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD

begin

 into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_tests v,
 valid_test_parms z,

 where v.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and sysdate between v.eff_date
 and nvl(v.term_date,sysdate)
 and t.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and z.parm_code = t.parm_code
 and z.run_flag = 'Y'
 and sysdate between z.eff_date
 and nvl(z.term_date, sysdate)

 and nvl(v.term_date,sysdate)
 and sysdate between t.eff_date
 and nvl(t.term_date,sysdate);

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 to_user exception;
 PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(to_user, -00054);
begin
 select accept_flag
 into :ctrl_blk_1.accept_flag
 from test_run_hdr
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id

exception

Item.Name: CONTINUE
Item.Hint: Enter Y to create new run or N to enter existing run.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor parms_cursor is
 select t.parm_code
 from test_parms t,
 valid_test_parms v
 where t.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and t.parm_type = :ctrl_blk_1.parm_type
 and t.parm_code = v.parm_code
 and v.run_flag = 'Y'
 and sysdate between v.eff_date
 and nvl(v.term_date,sysdate)
 and sysdate between t.eff_date
 and nvl(t.term_date,sysdate)
 order by t.sequence;
 temp_number number;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.continue = 'N'
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.continue := null;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.run_id');
 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.continue = 'Y'
 then
 select max_number + 1
 into temp_number
 from number_generation
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and number_type = 'RUN_ID'
 for update of max_number;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2011. IM 5318
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.run_id := to_char(v_local_time, 'mmddyy') || '-TR' || 
 lpad(to_char(temp_number), 4, '0'); -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 04/25/2011. IM 5318
 
 update number_generation
 set max_number = temp_number
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and number_type = 'RUN_ID';
 
 begin
 insert into test_run_hdr
 (chapter_id, run_id,
 test_id, parm_type,
 insert_date, program_id, testing_lab_code)
 values (:ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_1.run_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.test_id, :ctrl_blk_1.parm_type,
 sysdate, :banner.prog_name,:lab_code);
 temp_number := 1;
 for rec in parms_cursor
 loop
 insert into test_run_parms
 (chapter_id, run_id,
 sequence, parm_code, program_id)
 values (:ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_1.run_id,
 temp_number, rec.parm_code, :banner.prog_name);
 temp_number := temp_number + 1;
 end loop;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-startup');
 show_error('0230');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.run_id');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 else
 show_error('2104');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 loop

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_NUMERICS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_numerics (temp_rel_code varchar2) is
 temp_date date;
 temp_value number;
 chp_sysdate date; -- V02
 szDate DATE; -- V02 
begin
 if :parms.datatype = 'DATETIME'
 then
 -- convert/check syntax
 begin
 if NVL(length(:parms.parm_value), 0) = 10
 then
 :parms.parm_value := substr(:parms.parm_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,3,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,5,2) || ' ' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,7,2) || ':' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,9,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:parms.parm_value), 0) = 14
 then
 :parms.parm_value := substr(:parms.parm_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,4,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,7,2) || ' ' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,10,2) || ':' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,13,2);
 else
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 temp_date := to_rrdate(:parms.parm_value,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 exception
 when others then
 show_error('1708');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 -- V02
 if :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' then
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time( :GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 else
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 end if; 
 --
 
 -- check future date
 if temp_date > TRUNC(chp_sysdate, 'MI') -- sysdate -- V02
 then
 show_error('8030');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 -- calculate value to compare to range
 if :parms.related_code is not null
 then
 temp_value := round(
 24*60*(to_rrdate(:parms.parm_value,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')
 - to_rrdate(temp_rel_code, 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')),10);
 else

 -- V02
 if GLOBALVAR.datetime_value_lov is not null then
 szDate := to_date(to_char(GLOBALVAR.datetime_value_lov, 'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi'), 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 else
 szDate := to_date(to_char(chp_sysdate, 'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi'), 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 end if;

 
 temp_value := round(
 24 * 60 * (szDate - to_rrdate(:parms.parm_value, 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')),
 3); 
 ----------- 

 /* -- V02 
 temp_value := round(
 24*60*(trunc(sysdate,'MI')
 - to_rrdate(:parms.parm_value,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')),10);
 
 */
 if floor(temp_value) > round(nvl(:parms.accept_max,floor(temp_value)),10) then
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9006');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif ceil(temp_value) < round(nvl(:parms.accept_min,ceil(temp_value)-0.01),10) -- V02 (removed = sign)
 then
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9005');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :parms.accept_flag := 'Y';
 end if; 
 return; 
 end if;
 elsif :parms.datatype = 'DATE'
 then
 -- convert/check syntax
 begin
 if NVL(length(:parms.parm_value), 0) = 6
 then
 :parms.parm_value := substr(:parms.parm_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,3,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,5,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:parms.parm_value), 0) = 8
 then
 :parms.parm_value := substr(:parms.parm_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,4,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:parms.parm_value,7,2);
 else
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 temp_date := to_rrdate(:parms.parm_value,'MM-DD-RR');
 exception
 when others then
 show_error('1706');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 -- V02
 if :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' then
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time( :GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 else
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 end if; 
 -- 
 -- check future date
 if temp_date > TRUNC(chp_sysdate) -- SYSDATE -- V02
 then
 show_error('8030');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 ---
 
 -- calculate value to compare to range
 if :parms.related_code is not null
 then
 temp_value := round(to_rrdate(:parms.parm_value,'MM-DD-RR')
 - to_rrdate(temp_rel_code, 'MM-DD-RR'),0);
 else
 temp_value := round(trunc(chp_sysdate) -- sysdate -- V02
 - to_rrdate(:parms.parm_value,'MM-DD-RR'),0);
 end if;
 elsif :parms.datatype = 'NUMBER'
 then
 begin
 -- calculate value to compare to range
 if :parms.related_code is not null
 then
 temp_value := round(to_number(:parms.parm_value)
 - to_number(temp_rel_code),10);
 else
 temp_value := round(to_number(:parms.parm_value),10);
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 -- syntax check fails
 show_error('1707');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 -- check against range and set acceptability flag
 if temp_value > round(nvl(:parms.accept_max,temp_value),10)
 then
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9006');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif temp_value < round(nvl(:parms.accept_min,temp_value),10)
 then
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9005');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :parms.accept_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_value is
 temp_rel_code varchar2(14);
 temp_rel_parm varchar2(14);
 temp_cur_code varchar2(14);
 temp_cur_rec varchar2(4);
 temp_date date;
 temp_cnt number;
begin
 if :parms.datatype = 'DEVICE'
 then
 temp_date := sysdate;
 -- check device existance
 begin
 select equip_reference into temp_rel_code
 from equipment
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and equip_type = :parms.related_code
 and equip_id = :parms.parm_value
 and temp_date between first_production_date
 and nvl(last_production_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('3101');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- check qc data on device
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_cnt
 from equipment_event
 where equip_reference = temp_rel_code
 and temp_date between downtime_start
 and nvl(downtime_end, sysdate);
 if temp_cnt = 0
 then
 select count(*) into temp_cnt
 from equipment e
 where e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and e.equip_reference = temp_rel_code
 and e.status != 'IN';
 if temp_cnt = 0
 then
 select count(*) into temp_cnt
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr eqc, vequip_qc_frequency f
 where eqc.equip_type = :parms.related_code
 and eqc.qc_period = f.frequency_code
 and eqc.qc_period != 'V'
 and not exists
 (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr q1
 where q1.equip_reference = temp_rel_code
 and eqc.qc_type = q1.qc_type
 and qc_status = 'A'
 and decode(eqc.qc_period, 'H', sysdate, trunc(sysdate)) <
 decode (eqc.qc_period,
 'H', q1.qc_date+(1/24*eqc.frequency),
 'D', q1.qc_date+(1*eqc.frequency),
 'W', q1.qc_date+(7*eqc.frequency),
 add_months(q1.qc_date, (f.months*eqc.frequency))));
 end if;
 if temp_cnt != 0
 then
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9004');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :parms.accept_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 else
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9007');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parms.datatype = 'REAGENT'
 then
 temp_rel_parm := null;
 if :system.cursor_record != '1'
 then
 up;
 if :parms.datatype = 'DATETIME'
 then
 temp_rel_parm := :parms.parm_value;
 end if;
 down;
 end if;
 begin
 select expiry_date into temp_date
 from reagent_store_mst
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and reagent_code = :parms.related_code
 and reagent_id = :parms.parm_value;
 if temp_date < nvl(to_rrdate(temp_rel_parm,'mm/dd/RR hh24:mi'),sysdate)
 then
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9030');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :parms.accept_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('2509');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 -- not device or reagent, get value for related parameter
 if :parms.related_code is not null
 then
 temp_rel_code := :parms.related_code;
 temp_rel_parm := null;
 temp_cur_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :parms.parm_code = temp_rel_code
 then
 temp_rel_parm := :parms.parm_value;
 end if;
 down;
 exit when :system.cursor_record = temp_cur_rec;
 end loop;
 check_numerics(temp_rel_parm);
 if temp_rel_parm is null
 then
 show_error('3102');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 check_numerics(null);
 end if;
 -- check if other parameters reference the current one
 temp_rel_parm := :parms.parm_value;
 temp_cur_code := :parms.parm_code;
 temp_cur_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 loop
 down;
 if :parms.related_code = temp_cur_code and
 :parms.parm_value is not null
 then
 begin
 check_numerics(temp_rel_parm);
 highlight;
 exception
 when form_trigger_failure
 then
 go_record(temp_cur_rec);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 end loop;
 go_record(temp_cur_rec);
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE' and
 :parms.datatype = 'DATETIME'
 then
 down;
 if :parms.datatype = 'REAGENT' and
 :parms.parm_value is not null
 then
 check_value;
 end if;
 up;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POST_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure post_check is
begin
 if nvl(:GLOBAL.original_value,'xNULLx') !=
 nvl(:parms.parm_value,'xNULLx')
 then

 then

 else

 highlight;

 :parms.entry_tech := :banner.user_id;

 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-FORM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 --:global.program_version:='01';
 --:global.program_version:='02'; -- IM 2963
 --:global.program_version:='03'; -- IM 5318

 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 BEGIN
 SELECT testing_lab_code 
 INTO :lab_code
 FROM system_users 
 WHERE decode(substr(user_id,1,4) ,'OPS$',substr(user_id,5),user_id) 
 = :banner.user_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 t_result VARCHAR2(80);
 t_void_code VARCHAR2(5);
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.accept_flag is not null
 then
 begin
 update test_run_hdr
 set accept_flag = :ctrl_blk_1.accept_flag
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and run_id = :ctrl_blk_1.run_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_block = 'PARMS'
then
 go_record('1');
 loop
 :parms.accept_flag := null;
 highlight;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
end if;
